title: Ramesh Nath Pandey v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ withdrawn with liberty to raise a Clause 6.5 dispute.
headnote: A writ challenging a distribution licensee's notice dated 16.7.2017 was withdrawn after the Court recorded that a dispute under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 could be raised against such a notice, with liberty to pursue that remedy.
facts: Ramesh Nath Pandey filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court seeking to quash a notice dated 16 July 2017 issued by respondent no. 2. Counsel for the State and for respondent nos. 2 to 4, the distribution licensee, were heard. The Court recorded that it was not in dispute that a grievance against such a notice could be raised under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Confronted with that, the petitioner's counsel sought withdrawal with liberty to pursue that Code remedy.

holding_units.holding: A notice issued by the distribution licensee of the kind dated 16.7.2017 may be challenged by raising a dispute under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the writ challenging that notice was withdrawn with liberty to pursue that remedy.

not_decided.note: Petition withdrawn; the Court did not examine the merits of the notice.
